# Refgrow

> > Refgrow is an affiliate program management platform for SaaS companies, offering partner discovery, commission tracking, payout automation, and growth tools.

Refgrow helps software founders launch and scale affiliate programs with tools like the Affiliate Finder (matching products with potential partners), commission calculators, referral email templates, and integrated payout management through PayPal and Wise. The platform focuses on customer acquisition, conversion optimization, and partner program growth for B2B SaaS businesses.

## Key Topics

- Affiliate Marketing
- SaaS Growth Strategy
- Commission Tracking & Analysis
- Partner Program Management
- Customer Acquisition
- Conversion Optimization
- Influencer Outreach
- Referral Programs
- Affiliate Finder Tool
- Commission Rates & Calculators
- Payout Automation (PayPal, Wise)
- Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
- Affiliate Tracking Software
- B2B SaaS Marketing

## Core Platform & Tools

- [Pricing](https://refgrow.com/pricing): Transparent pricing plans for Refgrow affiliate program management
- [Referral Email Templates](https://refgrow.com/referral-email-templates): Free customizable email templates for referral program communications
- [Affiliate Commission Calculator](https://refgrow.com/affiliate-commission-calculator): Free calculator to project affiliate commissions and monthly earnings

## Documentation
